Keep session on window shrink
Keep CarPlay connected when a reverse or 360 camera window shrinks it

When the window shrinks inside its original size (for example a reverse or 360 camera view), scale the existing CarPlay picture instead of reconnecting at the new size. Rotation and bar changes still reconnect. On BYD head units with ADB authorized, this happens automatically while the reverse or 360 camera is shown, even with this option off; a session that connects while the camera is shown is sized for the normal window, so closing the camera does not reconnect.
Keep CarPlay connected when the screen turns (experimental)
Use a square canvas so CarPlay turns with the screen without reconnecting

When on, CarPlay connects with a square canvas (1920×1920 on a Song PLUS) holding a landscape and a portrait area; when the screen turns, the iPhone moves CarPlay to the matching area without reconnecting. A square is heavier to decode and send and may drop frames, and the custom safe area does not apply. If the long side exceeds 1920 or the head unit\'s decoder cannot take the square, the plain canvas is used. Applies on the next connection.
Fill the split-screen window (experimental)
In the head unit split screen CarPlay fills its window, without black bars or reconnecting

Needs Turn CarPlay with the screen above. The connection declares one more area the size of the split-screen window; entering split screen moves CarPlay there and leaving it moves CarPlay back, without reconnecting. The window is first estimated from the screen and its bars; after the first split screen its real size is remembered and fits exactly from the next connection. Not used by a connection that starts in split screen. Applies at the next connection.

Where CarPlay puts its app dock. Automatic: on the driver\'s side of a landscape screen and at the bottom of a portrait one, also with \"Keep CarPlay connected when the screen turns\" on. The driver\'s side follows the right-hand-drive setting. Changing this reconnects CarPlay.

Reads through ADB which apps and system services scan Wi-Fi, and writes it to the log. Frequent scans make Wi-Fi P2P stall. Export the logs afterwards.

Call audio channel
For calls on BYD head units try 6 (Bluetooth call channel) first, then 0 (call channel). The test tone plays through the chosen channel.
Lower AC fan during CarPlay calls
Temporarily lower the fan through BYD\'s public AC interface during CarPlay calls

Off by default. During CarPlay calls (WeChat included) the fan is lowered to the level below; it is only ever lowered, and nothing happens while the AC is off. When the call or session ends, or the app exits, the previous level or automatic mode is restored; if you change the fan during the call, your setting is kept. Needs ADB authorization (BYD group); does not depend on the car\'s own call fan reduction option.
Fan level during calls
Level %1$d
Only applies when the fan is above this level. Default: level 2. Takes effect from the next call.
Pause head-unit Wi-Fi search during CarPlay (recommended)
Reduces Wi-Fi scan interruptions; also stops installed Gaode navigation

Through authorized ADB, pauses automatic Wi-Fi search during wireless CarPlay. If Gaode Auto is installed, attempts to restrict its Wi-Fi scans and force-stops it once per connection, ending stock navigation. Wi-Fi scans by the system\'s Baidu network location are restricted too (it keeps running; network positioning may be coarser meanwhile). Search and the original permissions are restored 15 s after disconnect, or immediately when this option is disabled or the app exits. Turning the car off exits CarPlay and restores them at once; anything left is restored in the background after the next power-on, or, with auto-start on, after 60 s if CarPlay has not connected. Gaode is not relaunched. The head unit cannot automatically join saved Wi-Fi networks while search is paused. Needs ADB authorization (BYD group).

Allow the wired VPN automatically
No connection request dialog on each wired connection

Wired CarPlay needs Android to allow this app a VPN, used only for CarPlay; other apps keep their internet. With this on, the authorized ADB allows it before each wired connection, so the system connection request dialog does not appear. Without ADB authorization, or if it does not take, the dialog appears as before.
Song and lyrics on the cluster
CarPlay song in the instrument cluster\'s music card

Shows \"title — artist\" with play and pause; for lyrics, turn on car or Bluetooth lyrics in the music app (QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music…), which puts the current line in the title. Written through the authorized ADB link; the card shows as \"other\" music source.
Video
Video on the car screen while parked (experimental)
iOS 27: video sent to CarPlay on the iPhone plays on the car screen in P

Needs an iPhone on iOS 27. Plays only in P: the gear is read through BYD\'s interface in the app, or through head-unit ADB (authorized) where that is unavailable. Shifting out of P closes the player and the iPhone goes on with audio only, as it does when the gear cannot be read. The head unit downloads the video itself, so it needs internet access. Tap the picture for Back to CarPlay, play/pause, 10 s back and forward and the time bar; while the player is open, the steering-wheel play/pause key drives it and next/previous skip 10 s. Protected video such as Apple TV+ cannot play. Changing this reconnects CarPlay. Ported from DiPlay.
